name: Horner nested polynomial evaluation
definition: For P(x)=Σ_(j=0)^d a_j x^j, set b_d=a_d and b_j=a_j+x b_(j+1) for j=d−1,…,0; P(x)=b_0.
variables: d nonnegative degree; a_j coefficients; x scalar argument
assumptions: Finite scalar coefficients and argument in a commutative field; standard monomial basis
limitations: Cancellation and overflow can affect floating-point results; not a stable relative-error guarantee near roots
computation: Evaluate nested products and sums by descending coefficient order.

source.citation: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 1.11. https://dlmf.nist.gov/1.11

application: General polynomial evaluation; no forecasting benefit claimed.
mechanism_note: Provisional: nested evaluation recurrence; source and classification review pending.

name: Clenshaw Chebyshev series evaluation
variables: T_j first-kind Chebyshev polynomial; a_j full series coefficients; d nonnegative degree; x real argument
assumptions: Finite expansion with full constant coefficient and x in [−1,1]
limitations: Roundoff and cancellation remain possible, especially near endpoints; extrapolation may amplify error
computation: Run backward three-term recurrence and evaluate the final expression.

source.citation: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 3.11. https://dlmf.nist.gov/3.11

application: General Chebyshev expansion evaluation; no forecasting benefit claimed.
incompatible_methods: Coefficients in unrelated basis without conversion
mechanism_note: Provisional: backward recurrence for a three-term basis; source and classification review pending.
